node.title: Rate-half exceptional Hankel quotient-distance router
node.statement: On the official A=1 core-one exceptional-only sharp-cap profile, let W_A be the span of the moment columns at the r-1 roots of the exceptional locator A. The first-order syndrome h_1 has quotient support distance at least three modulo W_A. If the distance is exactly three, its residual-domain support triple is unique and its coefficients are the explicit Vandermonde-barycentric weights Theta_2/(A(x_i)^2 product_(j!=i)(x_i-x_j)); otherwise the quotient distance is at least four. This is an exhaustive source-intrinsic router, not an exclusion of either branch.
